name: Genevieve H. Dame
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Dunwoody, Georgia
education: Georgia State University College of Law
about: Genevieve H. Dame is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2018 - 2027. She works at Dame Law, located in Dunwoody, Georgia, and provides legal services for issues involving Business Litigation and General Litigation to the surrounding community.
Genevieve Dame completed legal studies at Georgia State University College of Law and graduated with the class of 2005. Genevieve Dame passed the bar in 2005.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
